description_en: Queries the information about a deployment package
description_zh: 调用GetDeployment获取发布包的详情
name: GetDeployment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the Workspace Manage icon in the upper-right corner of the DataStudio page to go to the Workspace Management page and view the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The GUID of the DataWorks workspace. You can view the GUID in the upper part of the DataStudio page. You can also select another GUID to switch to another workspace.

You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。

该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deployment task. A deployment task ID is generated when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173944.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173956.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 发布包的ID。执行https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173944.html 和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173956.html时，都会生成一个对应的发布包ID
parameters.name: deployment_id
